purpose: Server-side customer page data aggregator and resolver helpers for backend-driven storefront routes.
businessRules: Fetch home merchandising and category configuration from SHRESTA-BE together for customer pages.
Resolve public silk-sarees slug aliases to backend family keys such as silk_saree.
The silk_saree family key is used consistently for collection and category product resolution.
Collections with productBadgeFilters must resolve from backend product badges/tags using the same normalized token matching for every collection slug.
Do not introduce frontend-owned product, collection, category, asset, or store records.
Return null only on backend network unavailability or backend API 404 so route components can show the shared backend-unreachable state; rethrow other defects.
